name: prism-callee
description: Run the automated Prism lifecycle through Callee subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Automated Prism lifecycle with Callee subagents.
interface.longDescription: Runs the Prism lifecycle through Callee subagents until the story reaches the human gate, verification completes, or another stop condition is hit.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use /prism-callee:lifecycle to advance a Prism story automatically until it reaches the human gate or another stop condition.
